name: Remove Extra Spaces
summary: Clean up doubled spaces, trim lines, or collapse all whitespace in text.
description: Fix messy copy-paste text by collapsing repeated spaces per line, trimming line edges, or normalizing all whitespace into single spaces. Runs instantly in your browser.

faqs.question: Will line breaks be kept?
faqs.answer: In per-line modes, yes — only spaces on each line are affected unless you choose collapse all.

faqs.question: Tabs?
faqs.answer: Repeated spaces and tabs on a line are collapsed to a single space in collapse mode.
